intent.summary: Visually separates adjacent content regions without implying interactive resizing.
useWhen: A subtle boundary improves grouping comprehension
avoidWhen: Users can resize adjacent panes; use a split-view divider

semantics.sizing: one logical stroke by default across the parent cross axis

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Semantic border or separator color token.

accessibility.role: separator only when it conveys structure; otherwise none
notes: Purely decorative dividers are excluded from the accessibility tree.

mappings.strategy: Infer orientation from parent axis and preserve semantic color tokens.
